recommendedTextbook.title: New School Chemistry for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: Osei Yaw Ababio
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Modern periodic law and classification into s, p, d, f blocks
Periodic trends: Atomic radius, ionization energy, electronegativity
Properties of Group 1 alkali metals and Group 7 halogens
objectives: Explain periodic variation of electronegativity and electron affinity
Relate electronic configurations to chemical reactivities

subtopics: Definitions of oxidation and reduction in terms of oxygen, hydrogen and electrons
Determination of oxidation numbers in compounds and radicals
Balancing redox equations in acidic and basic media
objectives: Assign oxidation numbers to elements in complex ions
Identify oxidizing and reducing agents in given equations

topics.topic: Rates of Chemical Reactions and Chemical Equilibrium
subtopics: Factors affecting reaction rate: Temperature, concentration, catalyst, surface area
Le Chatelier's principle and equilibrium shift
objectives: Explain how catalysts lower activation energy
Predict equilibrium shifts under changing temperature and pressure
Calculate reaction rates from concentration-time curves

topics.topic: Acids, Bases, Salts and pH Concept
subtopics: Definition of pH, pOH, and Kw calculation
Types of salts: Normal, acid, basic, complex, and double salts
objectives: Distinguish strong from weak acids using dissociation constants
Calculate pH of strong monoprotic acids and bases
Identify salts that undergo hydrolysis in aqueous solutions
